queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_p
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
),
k AS (
  SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_p
  FROM t, b
  WHERE t.avg_p > b.baseline
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_p) AS kept_mean FROM k
)
SELECT AVG(k.avg_p) AS avg_type_average,
       AVG(k.avg_p - b.baseline) AS avg_diff_baseline,
       AVG(k.avg_p - m.kept_mean) AS avg_diff_kept_mean
FROM k, b, m
WHERE k.avg_p > m.kept_mean;
SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL
SELECT production_type_code FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM Products)
